# Trovenza Group & Jai Maa Tour & Travels

> Premier Government-Authorized Fleet, Luxury Pilgrimage, and Kedarnath VIP Helicopter Charter Operator headquartered in Haridwar, Uttarakhand, India.

- **Founder & Managing Director**: Trilok Rana
- **Designation**: Founder, Managing Director & Operations Head

## About Trilok Rana
Trilok Rana is an acclaimed Uttarakhand tourism entrepreneur and pilgrimage logistics specialist based in Haridwar. Over the past decade, under his leadership, Trovenza Group and Jai Maa Tour & Travels have served more than 45,000+ yatris and tourists across Uttarakhand, Himachal, Kashmir, and Rajasthan. His operations specialize in guaranteed commercial yellow-plate taxi fleets, VIP Kedarnath helicopter charter permits, satvik pilgrimage packages, and Vedic destination weddings at Triyuginarayan Temple.

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Dedicated Uttarakhand Pilgrimage & Tour Packages
- **Char Dham Yatra (9N/10D)**: Complete Haridwar-to-Haridwar sacred circuit covering Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath with 4-star mountain stays and oxygen-equipped backup.
- **Kedarnath VIP Helicopter Charter & Sugam Darshan (2N/3D)**: Round-trip confirmed helipad shuttle from Phata/Guptkashi/Dehradun, VIP priority darshan passes, and luxury cottage stay.
- **Auli + Chopta Tungnath Chandrashila Trek (4N/5D)**: World's highest Shiva shrine trek combined with Auli snow ski slopes.
- **Adi Kailash & Om Parvat Sacred Frontier (6N/7D)**: Inner-line permit authorized 4x4 expedition to the Indo-Tibet sacred frontier.
- **Triyuginarayan Temple Vedic Destination Wedding (2N/3D)**: Complete wedding packages at the sacred eternal flame temple where Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati wed.

### 2. Commercial Taxi & Fleet Operations (Haridwar & Delhi NCR)
All vehicles operate strictly under valid commercial yellow-plate passenger permits, comprehensive passenger insurance, and police-verified mountain-expert chauffeurs.
- **Sedan (Maruti Dzire)**: ₹12/km | Delhi-Haridwar One-Way: ₹3,600
- **Compact SUV (Maruti Ertiga 6-Seater)**: ₹14/km | Delhi-Haridwar One-Way: ₹4,200
- **Executive MPV (Toyota Innova Crysta)**: ₹18/km | Delhi-Haridwar One-Way: ₹5,000
- **Tempo Traveller (12/17/26 Seater)**: ₹28/km | Delhi-Haridwar One-Way: ₹12,000
- **Luxury Force Urbania VIP (10/13/17 Seater)**: ₹38/km | Delhi-Haridwar One-Way: ₹15,000
